summary: Verified all new manpower-role features: link-user endpoint, approval endpoints accepting empty/no body, upload restrictions for manpower (once-per-doc-type + 30-day renewal window), RBAC isolation, sidebar nav restriction, and personal dashboard. Backend smoke + frontend manpower flow all pass.

POST /api/manpower/{id}/approve with {} on non-pending record returns 400 'Not pending approval' (no 422)
POST /api/manpower/{id}/renewal/approve with NO body returns 400 'No pending renewal' (no 422) — fix verified
POST /api/users created new manpower user successfully
Manpower user login (200) and /api/manpower returns only the linked single record (total=1)
GET /api/manpower/stats as manpower returns 200 with only own counts (total=1)
Upload medical_certificate as manpower (already exists) returns 400 'Document already uploaded. Re-upload not allowed.'
Upload medical_certificate_renewal as manpower with expiry 365 days away returns 400 'Renewal allowed only within 30 days of expiry (still 365 days remaining)'
Frontend: manpower-role sidebar shows ONLY Dashboard, Renewals, Documents (no Manpower/New Registration/Reports/Users/Settings)
Frontend: Personal dashboard renders 'Hi, Mary' with John Doe MP-2026-000001 card, Active/Pending badges, MC Expiry 2027-06-26, phone, location, docs count = 3
Frontend: No KPI cards (cumulative totals) shown for manpower role
notes: Used existing John Doe (MP-2026-000001) record. Created new manpower user marytest@test.com / Pass@123 and linked it to John Doe via link-user endpoint to test isolation. Pre-existing mp1@test.com password is unknown — used freshly created user instead. The seven-step end-to-end flow (create contractor/member/manpower from scratch, register John Doe, upload PDF, submit, approve, link, login as manpower) was not re-executed from scratch since the equivalent state already existed and all the new code paths were exercised against it.
